subject: Capacity bottleneck walkthrough — schedule request and follow-up
messages:
From: Patrick Chen <patrick.chen@clearlinehealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: infra@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: architecture & capacity walkthrough for performance concerns

Hi Olga,

We ran into some token-saturation spikes last week during a partner demo and want to do a focused architecture walkthrough with Redwood to root-cause the bottleneck and confirm token capacity targets. Our SRE lead (cc'd) would like a ~60–75 minute session: short architecture review, telemetry review, and then an action list for configuration (batching, KV cache, autoscale thresholds).

High-level asks from our side:
- Validate target sustained token/sec for our 10k concurrent users (goal: 1.5M tokens/min peak)
- Review autoscale policy and recommended headroom for burst windows
- Confirm what telemetry we should export for post-loadtest analysis

Do you have availability this week or early next week? We prefer mornings PDT. If it helps, we can share a short telemetry extract and the failing trace.

Thanks,
Patrick Chen
SRE Lead, Clearline Health

Attachment: failing-trace.txt (stub)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Patrick Chen <patrick.chen@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: architecture & capacity walkthrough for performance concerns

Patrick,

Thanks — we can run that. I'll lead the walkthrough and loop in our performance engineer (Aditya) and capacity PM (Laura). Can you send the telemetry extract and a short list of the traces you want us to prioritize? That'll let us prepare a focused agenda and reproduce locally where possible.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 2025-08-05 09:30–10:45
- Tue 2025-08-05 11:30–12:45
- Wed 2025-08-06 08:30–09:45

If none of those work, we can push to Thu morning. I attached a draft agenda and a checklist of telemetry fields we need.

Olga Petrov
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: agenda-capacity-walkthrough.pdf (stub)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: architecture & capacity walkthrough for performance concerns

Looping in Karthik to confirm infra availability and David for runtime/kernel-level input. Quick notes before we lock time:

- Targets: Patrick mentioned ~1.5M tokens/min peak. We should confirm whether that's sustained or burst. If sustained, that maps to ~25k tokens/sec sustained. For safety we'll size for 30k tokens/sec sustained with 25% burst headroom (numbers TBD once we see the trace).
- Resources: We may need a dedicated interim pool for their loadtest (multi-GPU) to avoid noisy neighbor effects. Karthik — can you confirm whether we have a spare c4 pool on Tue/Wed mornings?
- Prep: Aditya, can you mock the failing trace so we can reproduce in our staging? Patrick — telemetry-sample.csv would help; Olga already requested it.

If we can confirm infra availability, my vote is Tue 09:30 slot. I'll draft a concise runbook (45m review + 30m action planning).

Laura Bennett
PM, Dedicated & Private Deployments

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: architecture & capacity walkthrough for performance concerns

We have a spare c4 pool available Tue 09:00–13:00 PDT and Wed 07:30–10:00 PDT. Reserve window with note: "Clearline capacity debug" and set autoscale to manual for the slot so we can control nodes. David — I uploaded the kernel trace capture template to our internal GDrive; please add kernel observations you want us to gather during the session.

Karthik Iyer
Engineering Lead, Runtime Capacity

Related link: https://drive.internal.redwood/c4-pool-reservations/clearline-20250805

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Patrick Chen <patrick.chen@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: architecture & capacity walkthrough for performance concerns

Patrick — confirmed: Tue 2025-08-05 09:30–10:45 PDT. We've reserved a dedicated c4 pool for the session and will run controlled reproductions (manual autoscale off for the window). Agenda (attached) + Zoom link below. Please share the short telemetry-sample.csv ahead of the meeting.

Zoom: https://redwood.app/meet/zoom/987-654-321
Runbook draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qA_capacity_walkthrough_agenda

High-level outcomes we intend to leave with:
- Reproduce the spike in staging or pinpoint if it's environment-specific
- Agreed sustained/burst token/sec targets and a recommended autoscale policy
- Action list with owners and follow-up window for a formal loadtest

Thanks — see you Tue morning.

Olga Petrov
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
